From 019f87f1ef967c5a5b263f21ad100f46c874505a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Marek=20Beh=C3=BAn?= <kabel@kernel.org>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2024 10:57:53 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] platform: cznic: turris-omnia-mcu: Make watchdog code
 optional
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Make the watchdog part of the driver optional, under a boolean config
option. Move the dependency to WATCHDOG to this new option, and change
the WATCHDOG_CORE dependency to selection, as is done in most watchdog
drivers.

This makes the turris-omnia-mcu driver available for compilation even if
WATCHDOG is disabled.

Fixes: ed46f1f7731d ("platform: cznic: turris-omnia-mcu: fix Kconfig dependencies")
Signed-off-by: Marek Behún <kabel@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240719085756.30598-2-kabel@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>

diff --git a/drivers/platform/cznic/turris-omnia-mcu.h b/drivers/platform/cznic/turris-omnia-mcu.h
index 2ca56ae13aa9..85bf9ab39356 100644
--- a/drivers/platform/cznic/turris-omnia-mcu.h
+++ b/drivers/platform/cznic/turris-omnia-mcu.h
@@ -47,8 +47,10 @@ struct omnia_mcu {
 	u32 rtc_alarm;
 	bool front_button_poweron;
 
+#ifdef CONFIG_TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG
 	/* MCU watchdog */
 	struct watchdog_device wdt;
+#endif
 
 	/* true random number generator */
 	struct hwrng trng;
@@ -189,6 +191,14 @@ extern const struct attribute_group omnia_mcu_poweroff_group;
 int omnia_mcu_register_gpiochip(struct omnia_mcu *mcu);
 int omnia_mcu_register_sys_off_and_wakeup(struct omnia_mcu *mcu);
 int omnia_mcu_register_trng(struct omnia_mcu *mcu);
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG
 int omnia_mcu_register_watchdog(struct omnia_mcu *mcu);
+#else
+static inline int omnia_mcu_register_watchdog(struct omnia_mcu *mcu)
+{
+	return 0;
+}
+#endif
 
 #endif /* __TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_H */
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/drivers/platform/cznic/Makefile b/drivers/platform/cznic/Makefile
index eae4c6b341ff..7599b4835056 100644
--- a/drivers/platform/cznic/Makefile
+++ b/drivers/platform/cznic/Makefile
@@ -5,4 +5,4 @@ turris-omnia-mcu-y		:= turris-omnia-mcu-base.o
 turris-omnia-mcu-y		+= turris-omnia-mcu-gpio.o
 turris-omnia-mcu-y		+= turris-omnia-mcu-sys-off-wakeup.o
 turris-omnia-mcu-y		+= turris-omnia-mcu-trng.o
-turris-omnia-mcu-y		+= turris-omnia-mcu-watchdog.o
+turris-omnia-mcu-$(CONFIG_TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG)		+= turris-omnia-mcu-watchdog.o

diff --git a/drivers/platform/cznic/Kconfig b/drivers/platform/cznic/Kconfig
index cb0d4d686d8a..b56c343e21d6 100644
--- a/drivers/platform/cznic/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/platform/cznic/Kconfig
@@ -17,11 +17,9 @@ config TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU
 	depends on MACH_ARMADA_38X || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on I2C
 	depends on OF
-	depends on WATCHDOG
 	depends on GPIOLIB
 	depends on HW_RANDOM
 	depends on RTC_CLASS
-	depends on WATCHDOG_CORE
 	select GPIOLIB_IRQCHIP
 	help
 	  Say Y here to add support for the features implemented by the
@@ -31,7 +29,6 @@ config TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU
 	    disabled) and the ability to configure wake up from this mode (via
 	    rtcwake)
 	  - true random number generator (if available on the MCU)
-	  - MCU watchdog
 	  - GPIO pins
 	    - to get front button press events (the front button can be
 	      configured either to generate press events to the CPU or to change
@@ -44,7 +41,21 @@ config TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU
 	      to be able to program SOC's OTP on board revisions 32+
 	    - to get input from the LED output pins of the WAN ethernet PHY, LAN
 	      switch and MiniPCIe ports
+	  Other features can be enabled by subsequent config options.
 	  To compile this driver as a module, choose M here; the module will be
 	  called turris-omnia-mcu.
 
+if TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU
+
+config TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG
+	bool "Turris Omnia MCU watchdog"
+	default y
+	depends on WATCHDOG
+	select WATCHDOG_CORE
+	help
+	  Say Y here to add support for watchdog provided by CZ.NIC's Turris
+	  Omnia MCU.
+
+endif # TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU
+
 endif # CZNIC_PLATFORMS

### Modifications Summary

#### Modifications in Each File:

1. **turris-omnia-mcu.h**:
   - Wrapped the `watchdog_device` structure and the `omnia_mcu_register_watchdog` function declaration in preprocessor conditionals (`#ifdef CONFIG_TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG`). This makes the watchdog code optional, allowing it to be excluded if the configuration option is not enabled.
   - Added an inline function that returns 0 for `omnia_mcu_register_watchdog` when the watchdog is not enabled.

2. **Makefile**:
   - Changed the way the watchdog object file (`turris-omnia-mcu-watchdog.o`) is included in the build. It is now conditionally added based on the `CONFIG_TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG` configuration option.

3. **Kconfig**:
   - Introduced a new configuration option `CONFIG_TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG`, which is a boolean option that defaults to 'y' and depends on the `WATCHDOG` option.
   - Removed the direct dependency on `WATCHDOG` and `WATCHDOG_CORE` from the `TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU` configuration, instead selecting `WATCHDOG_CORE` if the new watchdog option is enabled.

#### Relationships:
- The modifications in the **Kconfig** file establish a new configuration option that controls the inclusion of the watchdog functionality in the driver. This change allows the driver to be compiled without the watchdog code if the new option is disabled.
- The changes in **turris-omnia-mcu.h** and **Makefile** are directly related to the new Kconfig option, as they conditionally include the watchdog code and its associated object file based on whether `CONFIG_TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG` is enabled. This ensures that the driver remains functional and compilable even when the watchdog feature is not required.

1. **Kconfig (drivers/platform/cznic/Kconfig)**:
   - Removed the direct dependency on `WATCHDOG` and `WATCHDOG_CORE` from the `TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU` configuration.
   - Introduced a new boolean configuration option `TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG` that depends on `WATCHDOG` and selects `WATCHDOG_CORE`.
   - Updated help text to clarify the purpose of the new watchdog configuration option.

2. **turris-omnia-mcu.h (drivers/platform/cznic/turris-omnia-mcu.h)**:
   - Wrapped the declaration of the `watchdog_device` structure and the function `omnia_mcu_register_watchdog` with preprocessor directives that check if `CONFIG_TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG` is enabled.

The modifications establish a new optional configuration for the watchdog feature in the Turris Omnia MCU driver. By creating the `TURRIS_OMNIA_MCU_WATCHDOG` option, the driver can now be compiled without the watchdog functionality if desired. This is achieved by:

- Adjusting the Kconfig file to manage dependencies more flexibly, allowing the driver to be compiled even when the watchdog is disabled.
- Modifying the header file to conditionally include watchdog-related structures and functions, ensuring that they are only present when the watchdog feature is enabled.
- Updating the Makefile to include the watchdog source file only if the new configuration option is set, thus preventing unnecessary compilation of watchdog code when it is not needed.

Overall, these changes enhance the configurability of the driver, making it more versatile for different use cases.
